statements.quote: Pusztai reported that the rats fed these GM potatoes experienced stunted growth, a suppressed immune system, and a thickening of the stomach and intestinal lining (mucosa).

source.title: Dr. Arpad Pusztai's GM potato experiments (Google AI Overview)

statements.note: Rats, Dr. Arpad Pusztai, Rowett Research Institute, Scotland, 1998; partly published in The Lancet, 1999. Rats fed normal potatoes mixed with the same snowdrop lectin were not affected. Pusztai was suspended, his data confiscated, and he was banned from speaking publicly.
